bezout_identity.statement: Sres_1(P,P_u) lies in the ideal (P, P_u) in R[u]
bezout_identity.note: Cofactors U,V with U*P+V*P_u = Sres_1 exist by the subresultant PRS; not expanded as sparse multipolynomials

s1_unit_on_open.claim: s_1 is a unit on D(ell * P_uu * C * delta * G) intersect V(H)

modular_discovery.result: Across primes 71,101,103,107 with hundreds of V(H) points in D(L,M,Q4,ell,C,Puu-content), count of s1=0 was 0. Rare s1=0 points on unrestricted V(H) always had ell=0 (and often M=0 or L=0).
modular_discovery.not_a_certificate: Modular nonvanishing is not an exact unit certificate (workorder / REPAIR)

accepted_exact_certificates_missing: radical/Nullstellensatz for the deg-gcd>=2 locus vs gates
exact factor containment of s1 in gate divisors
exact Bézout identity with explicitly invertible coefficient on the open

isomorphism_S_G_B_G.obstruction: s1 unit on the full open not certified exactly; map is well-defined on D(s1) only

partial_statement_proved.statement: On D(s1) cap D(ell) cap V(H) where deg gcd(P,P_u)=1, the algebra Q(A,B,Y,Z)[u]/(P,P_u) is generated by u = -s0/s1 over the base
partial_statement_proved.scope: does not upgrade to S_G ≅ B_G without unit of s1 on the open
